summary.name: Jigso Sidekick
summary.one_liner: Jigso is a Slack app that gives free access to ChatGPT 4.0 and lets you ask organizational apps questions, track topics, set reminders, query documents and summarize Slack conversations.
use_cases: ask questions across organizational apps from Slack
get ChatGPT answers without leaving Slack
summary.what_it_does: Jigso is a Slack-based assistant that provides access to ChatGPT 4.0 directly inside Slack. It lets users ask questions of their organization's apps using natural language. The page also lists tracking important topics, setting reminders, querying documents, and summarizing conversations in Slack. The page is primarily promotional and gives no technical detail on how these features work.
notable: Can query organizational apps and documents in natural language
Summarizes Slack conversations and tracks topics
caveats: Page does not state limits, paid tiers, or data handling details
Only Slack is named as a platform
